items.reason: Bevacizumab is given for radiation necrosis, but rule 2 (supportive) applies only if the record states no antitumour outcome, and it lists 'Tumour progression free survival' and 'Radiologic response according to the RANO criteria'. Bevacizumab is a D6 established GBM therapy tested in a new setting and as the question ('Bevacizumab Versus Corticosteroids'), so rule 6 -> established_therapy_only.

note: Either way the trial has no candidate; only the S6 exclusion reason (Figure 1) changes. The trial's purpose is clearly symptom control of radiation necrosis (primary outcomes KPS/NANO/dexamethasone), so 'supportive' -> no_pharmacological_candidate is defensible if XL reads the tumour PFS/RANO secondaries as safety monitoring rather than an antitumour outcome. target_engagement_planned set unclear (blood Olink/platelet RNA response markers not linked to a candidate, per W7 wording); priority 3 only. Population includes brain metastases of any solid tumour; coders agree mixed_glioma_gbm_named (basket arguable).
